name: Motobecane Mobylette / 50V
engine: 49 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, variator, premix, pedals
intro: The French mopeds. A belt variator, premix and a pressed-steel or tube frame depending on model.

B: Moped two-strokes run premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual, usually around 50 to 1 with modern oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
